description:
This video explores the socioeconomic trade-offs of waste management, examining who bears the costs and who holds the power to decide. It delves into the environmental justice implications of different waste strategies, including source reduction, recycling, composting, incineration, and landfilling. The video highlights the disparities in waste management costs and decision-making power, particularly in low-income communities and the importance of considering the full lifecycle effects and spatial distribution of waste management strategies. It also discusses the role of Extended Producer Responsibility and the need for transparent monitoring and accountability in waste management.

title: The Hidden Costs of Waste: Who Pays, Who Decides?
